title: BC Friday Tips #27 Replace Blank Values using Transformation Rules
summary: Transformation Rules can replace blank values in Business Central using regular expressions. Set the transformation type to "Replace" and use the pattern ^$ to match empty strings without requiring any development.
key_points: Use regular expressions with Transformation Rules to identify and replace empty values
The pattern ^$ matches start and end of string to identify blank entries
No custom development is needed; this works out of the box

quotes.text: Set Transformation Type to Replace by using Regular Expressions
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the first step to configure blank value replacement in Business Central
Understanding this regex pattern is key to implementing the blank value replacement

quotes.text: Work out of the box. No development needed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows this feature requires no AL code or custom development, making it accessible to all users
